items.title: Harold Dejan Interview, 1960-10-14
items.q: and then Bob Wachers would say sometime, look, y'all want to play a little breakfast dance or picnic or something?

ctx.x: Close to the camp, close to it. On the side of the baudouin? Yeah, no, Spokin Mary didn't come all the way in front of the Japanese Tea Garden. They had a little, it comes about where Moreau's Grocery is right now. Yeah, I know. And the grocery's there right now. Me and Sidney Miner, you and my brother, and the band, Joe Cliff, I never, Reuben McClendon, McClendon, that he's away from the Southern Moccan Company right now. Well, we were playing at Moreau's Camp in 1928, at Lilwood's. And Moreau's got the same…

As you were saying, it's good to catch up on a few of these little things that we might forget later. Who was the fellow that you told us about that took the clarinet apart and ended up playing on the mouthpiece?
